Type: rug
Name: Amazon Brand – Ravenna Home Vintage Damask Patterned Rug, 5'3" x 7'3", Ivory on Warm Grey
Colors: Grey
5'3"W x 7'3"L 100% polypropylene; backing: 100% latex This gorgeous rug is power loomed with striated tones of ivory-white on a warm grey field, bringing an elegance to your favorite room. The medium 0.5" pile suits any indoor space. Pair with rug pad (sold separately)
